item.title: Aperialblocks Band Builder joins ArthurTube.github.io
item.description: The Aperialblocks Band Builder supports Bands 35 through 510 (numbers 341 through 5100). Official/canon Aperial material is credited to Aperial10080, while builder-generated drafts remain separate.
